name: Redstone Block Description
description:
Hover over redstone-related items in your inventory to see block functions and operating conditions.

Controls
• Shift: open photos and detailed help
• Mouse wheel: scroll long descriptions
• Pin key (default H): keep Shift help open
• Pinned guide: contents, pause, previous/next photo
• Esc: close the pinned guide
Change the pin key: Options → Controls → Key Binds → Redstone Block Description

Enable or disable help
/rbd on: enable · /rbd off: disable
/rbd toggle: switch · /rbd status: check
Your preference is saved between sessions.

Included references
233 vanilla items · 71 topics
190 real in-game photos
Container quantities and comparator output, music-disc outputs, note-block instruments, special dispenser actions and more.

Requirements
Minecraft Java 26.2 · Fabric Loader 0.19.5+
Fabric API 0.160.0+26.2 · Java 25+
Korean and English. Client-only; no server installation needed.
